run_downloads: run the python module to download VG_Relation, VG_Attribution, and COCO_Order datasets into ARO_DIR and COCO_DIR
run_VG_Relation: run the python module to instantiate and download the VG_Relation dataset with a custom image preprocess function
run_VG_Attribution: run the python module to instantiate and download the VG_Attribution dataset with a custom image preprocess function
run_COCO_Order: run the python module to instantiate and download the COCO_Order dataset into the COCO_DIR directory
run_main: run the python module as a script to download all ARO and COCO datasets automatically
